evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

limitation_declared: The scenario input tuple for 'syndra_custom_order_120' (champion level, item build, ability ranks, manual-target resistances/HP, fight window) is defined in scripts/golden_snapshot.py, which runbook R-18/R-19 forbids this oracle from reading. It does not appear anywhere in the permitted export (grep for 'custom_order', 'manual_target', 'damage_by_type' over data/ and docs/math-foundations.md returns nothing). The absolute total therefore cannot be reproduced from primary sources alone. What IS fully determinable from the cached wiki text is the DELTA: what mechanic can and cannot produce exactly +713.0 magic damage. All four candidate explanations are tested below; three are eliminated outright and the survivor is the wiki-mandated behaviour that this scenario exists to exercise.

sources_quoted.quote: At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence, increasing her ability power by 15%.
sources_quoted.use: Fixes the 120-splinter AP multiplier at exactly 1.15x.

sources_quoted.quote: Innate: Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath that enhance each of her abilities based on the number of them collected, stacking up to 120 times.
sources_quoted.use: Confirms the '120' in the scenario name is the max-splinter (Transcendent) state, so every Transcendent Bonus tier (40 / 60 / 80 / 100) is simultaneously active.

sources_quoted.quote: Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.
sources_quoted.use: At 120 splinters Dark Sphere is a 2-charge ability, so a fight window contains a stocked extra Q cast beyond the plain-cooldown count.
Dark Sphere magic damage = base(rank) + 70% AP, AP ratio identical at every rank.

sources_quoted.source: data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.W[0] / E[0] / R[0] leveling blocks
sources_quoted.quote: W Force of Will: [70,100,130,160,190] + 65% AP magic. E Scatter the Weak: [60,95,130,165,200] + 60% AP magic. R Unleashed Power 'Magic Damage per Sphere': [80,120,160] + 20% AP, 'Minimum Magic Damage' 3 spheres, 'Maximum Magic Damage' 7 spheres.
sources_quoted.use: Full packet table for Syndra's magic damage. Note every AP ratio is rank-invariant (0.70 / 0.65 / 0.60 / 0.20-per-sphere) and every flat base is a multiple of 5 -- the two invariants the eliminations below hang on.

sources_quoted.quote: Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances Force of Will to deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage.
sources_quoted.use: The 60-splinter tier routes its bonus into the TRUE bucket, not the magic bucket -- so it cannot be the cause of a change in damage_by_type/magic.

sources_quoted.quote: Stat rounding (calculate_total_stats) | display-level integer rounding of health/AD/AP/armor/MR before damage | APPROX
sources_quoted.use: AP is an integer at damage time, which is why the extra-cast fit below lands on exact integers.

sources_quoted.quote: A part with h identical hits is mitigated per hit and summed: SUM_h m(R)*raw = h*m(R)*raw ... the mitigation operator x -> x*100/(100+R) is linear in raw damage for a fixed resistance.
sources_quoted.use: Justifies factoring the post-mitigation total as m * raw and treating a whole extra cast as m * (base + ratio*AP).

sources_quoted.quote: E3 implemented the Transcendent splinter system (splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot, 60+ W true damage), R sphere count (r_spheres).
sources_quoted.use: Independent confirmation (audit data, not source code) that the 120-splinter state is modelled as three separate levers, and that the Q charge is carried by a distinct 'Q2' cast slot -- the slot a custom cast order can drop.

independent_computation.step_0_what_the_delta_must_be: damage_by_type/magic is a post-mitigation sum over cast instances. By S8 it factors as m * SUM_i (base_i + ratio_i * AP_eff), with m = 100/(100+MR) fixed for the fight and AP_eff = 1.15 * AP by S1. Any explanation of +713.0 must therefore be (a) a change in AP_eff, (b) a change in ability RANKS (base_i only, since S5 makes every ratio rank-invariant), or (c) a change in which cast instances occur.

hypothesis_A_transcendence_ap_toggle.claim: old omitted the 15% Transcendence AP buff; new applies it.
hypothesis_A_transcendence_ap_toggle.consequence: That requires 92.42% of the old magic total to be AP-scaled, i.e. an AP-part to flat-base ratio of 12.20:1.
hypothesis_A_transcendence_ap_toggle.check_against_S5: Rank-5 Syndra packets need AP_eff = 4008 (Q), 3566 (W), 4066 (E), or 4305 (a Q+W+E+R[3 spheres] rotation) to reach a 12.20:1 AP-to-base ratio. No reachable League build produces ~4000 AP.
hypothesis_A_transcendence_ap_toggle.verdict: ELIMINATED. The delta is not the Transcendence AP buff being switched on or off, in either direction.

hypothesis_B_ability_rank_change.claim: the 'custom order' seeded different ability ranks; only flat bases move.
hypothesis_B_ability_rank_change.algebra: By S5 every AP ratio is rank-invariant, so a pure re-ranking moves only flat bases, and every flat base and every rank step is a multiple of 5 (Q step 35, W step 30, E step 35, R step 40/sphere). Hence the RAW delta must be a multiple of 5, and 713.0 = m * raw  =>  raw = 7.13 * (100 + MR).
hypothesis_B_ability_rank_change.check: 7.13*(100+MR) is a multiple of 5 only when 713*(100+MR) == 0 mod 500; gcd(713,500)=1, so 100+MR must be a multiple of 500, i.e. MR = 400. Swept MR = 0..200 in steps of 5: zero admissible values.
hypothesis_B_ability_rank_change.verdict: ELIMINATED. No realistic magic-resist value lets a pure ability-rank change land on exactly 713.0. Whatever 'custom_order' shifted, it was not just ranks -- an AP-scaled term entered or left the sum.

hypothesis_C_r_sphere_count.claim: Unleashed Power collected a different number of Dark Spheres (S5: 3 to 7).
hypothesis_C_r_sphere_count.algebra: one extra sphere at rank 3 = m*(160 + 0.20*AP_eff) = 713  =>  AP_eff = (713/m - 160)/0.20.
hypothesis_C_r_sphere_count.check: m=1.0 -> AP_eff 2765; m=0.8 (MR 25) -> 3656; m=0.5 (MR 100) -> 6330. Two spheres would need AP_eff 1965 / 2622 / 4485. All far outside any reachable build.
hypothesis_C_r_sphere_count.verdict: ELIMINATED. The delta is not the r_spheres lever.

hypothesis_D_one_extra_cast.claim: exactly one additional ability instance is present in the new value.
hypothesis_D_one_extra_cast.note: Dark Sphere is the unique packet in S4/S5 that lands on an exactly integral, exactly Transcendence-consistent parameterisation: AP 600 -> 600*1.15 = 690 -> 230 + 483 = 713.0. Per S7 the engine rounds AP to an integer before damage, so an integral fit is the expected signature and the W/E fits are the anomalous ones. (An MR>0 target admits other fits, e.g. MR 25 with AP ~821 for Q, so this is corroboration, not proof of the exact stat line.)
hypothesis_D_one_extra_cast.verdict: SURVIVES, and it is the only survivor.

independent_computation.step_final_which_direction_is_correct: By S3, at 120 splinters Dark Sphere periodically stocks a charge up to a maximum of 2 -- so a fight window at max splinters contains one stocked Q cast beyond the plain-cooldown schedule. S9 confirms that charge is carried by a distinct 'Q2' cast slot, exactly the kind of slot a custom cast order can fail to seed. A scenario whose entire name is 'splinters = 120' exists to exercise the Transcendent tiers; a magic total that omits the stocked Dark Sphere cast is the pre-charge (wiki-incorrect) count. The delta is +1 Dark Sphere, in the direction of honouring S3, and its magnitude of 713.0 is exactly one rank-5 Dark Sphere at Transcendence-buffed AP. The higher value is the wiki-consistent one.
independent_computation.residual_risk: Because the scenario's input tuple is outside the permitted evidence tree, this oracle verified the delta, not the absolute total. It cannot rule out that the new value adds a THIRD stocked Q beyond the 2-charge cap of S3, nor that the absolute total is off by an unrelated constant shared by both values. A cheap follow-up that would close this without violating R-18: expose the Q cast count for this scenario and confirm it is <= 2 charges above the plain-cooldown schedule.

computation_reproducer:
python - <<'EOF'
d = 5856.0 - 5143.0                      # 713.0
# Hypothesis A (Transcendence 1.15x AP toggle), S1 + S5
K_AP = d/0.15; B = 5143 - K_AP
print('AP-scaled fraction of old total:', K_AP/5143)        # 0.9242 -> needs ~4000 AP, impossible
# Hypothesis B (pure rank change): S5 bases/steps are all multiples of 5
for mr in range(0, 201, 5):
    raw = d * (100+mr)/100
    assert abs(raw/5 - round(raw/5)) > 1e-9                   # no MR admits it
# Hypothesis D (one extra cast) at m = 1
for name, base, ratio in [('Q5',230,.70), ('W5',190,.65), ('E5',200,.60), ('R3/sphere',160,.20)]:
    ap_eff = (d-base)/ratio
    print(name, ap_eff, ap_eff/1.15)                          # Q5 -> 690.0, 600.0 exactly
EOF
